character: Historic 4.9km circuit, narrow and technical with limited overtaking. Undulating, flowing, and punishing mistakes with little runoff. Precision and curb management are key.
sources: https://www.formula1.com/en/racing/2026/emilia-romagna/circuit official F1 circuit guide; Tamburello/Villeneuve/Tosa/Rivazza naming long-established

corners.name: Variante Tamburello
corners.technique: Brake from 6th to 2nd gear, late apex T2, use sausage kerbs carefully. T4 kink should be flat with correct line
corners.trap: Running wide out of the chicane makes T4 impossible to take flat

corners.name: Villeneuve
corners.technique: Hard braking, precise through both apexes. Use inside kerbs but avoid sausages
corners.trap: Too aggressive over kerbs triggers TC intervention and snap oversteer

corners.name: Tosa
corners.technique: Brake after 50m board, 2nd gear, mid-to-late apex. Trail brake heavily, get on power early as exit opens
corners.trap: Early apex prevents early throttle application

corners.name: Piratella
corners.technique: Near-flat or light braking, use the elevation to your advantage. Commitment rewarded
corners.trap: Lifting kills momentum through the fast section that follows

corners.name: Acque Minerali
corners.technique: Brake at 50m board for T11, 3rd gear, clip inside. Quick throttle blip between apexes to settle car, then commit to T12-T13
corners.trap: Aggressive turn-in while braking causes rear rotation; need smooth weight transfer

corners.name: Variante Alta
corners.technique: Hard braking, carry speed to late apex. Critical exit feeds Rivazza approach
corners.trap: Compromising exit speed by over-driving the entry

corners.name: Rivazza 1
corners.technique: Brave entry, trail brake to apex, use camber for grip
corners.trap: Braking too early wastes the downhill advantage

corners.name: Rivazza 2
corners.technique: Late apex, progressive throttle. Exit speed feeds start/finish straight
corners.trap: Early apex = wheelspin on exit = slow pit straight
